integration_policy: Original compatibility metadata and adapter logic. Prefer the installed upstream pack's own workflows and live ComfyUI schemas instead of duplicating private frontend state.
major_capabilities: video extension and timeline video segments
IC-LoRA reference video and reference image workflows
video loading, trimming, resizing, and preview
workflow_rules: Treat timeline_data, local_prompts, segment_lengths, and guide_strength as frontend-managed state. Do not guess widget indexes or hand-edit serialized timeline state unless a live-schema-aware edit path validates it.
Use the installed pack's own example workflows as the preferred creation baseline.
Use live /object_info node schemas before changing connections or widget values.
LTX Director supports Prompt Relay for multiple prompt segments; single-prompt timelines may bypass relay masking for speed.
The Director can auto-create an LTXV latent when optional_latent is not connected.
LTXV frame lengths follow the pack's 8n+1 temporal rule for auto-generated latents.
Use CLIPLoader type ltxv in current LTX workflows unless the installed example/live schema proves a different loader path.
Guide images may be first, middle, or last-frame anchors; end-frame behavior is represented by timeline segment state.
Custom audio, audio inpainting, IC-LoRA motion/reference media, and Retake Mode are separate features and should only be enabled when the requested workflow requires them.
Keep original source workflows before editing and return a workflow diff for nontrivial changes.
upstream_dependencies: ComfyUI-LTXVideo for current LTX Director workflows
ComfyUI-KJNodes for workflows/features that use KJNodes
ComfyUI-GGUF when using the upstream GGUF example workflow

example_workflow_preferences.fflf_3_stage: LTX I2V First Last Frame 3 Stage Workflow v6.json

common_failures.frontend_stale: After updating the pack, restart ComfyUI and hard-reload the browser when the timeline UI is stale or missing.
common_failures.ltx_dependency_mismatch: Update the LTXVideo/KJNodes dependencies used by the selected upstream workflow and validate their live node schemas.
common_failures.clip_loader_type: Current upstream notes call out CLIPLoader type ltxv for LTX workflows.
common_failures.timeline_state: Do not repair timeline_data by guessed string/widget positions. Use the Director frontend or a validated schema-aware adapter.
common_failures.missing_media: Director media may live under the ComfyUI input/whatdreamscost workspace; preserve project-relative references and verify files exist.

runtime_authority: Live ComfyUI node schemas and the installed upstream pack override this static knowledge when versions differ.
